title: Score retrieval per question and record each run immutably
problem: A mean retrieval score that rises can hide questions whose gold passage fell out of the top k. Retrieval has to be scored per question, against a retriever the harness does not own, and each run kept so a later change can be compared with it.
context: Builds on the validated corpus and question set. The retriever is a function the learner defines the interface for; the harness ships a deterministic example retriever such as keyword overlap, which is enough to exercise the metrics.
impact: This is the first measurement the harness produces. If it is wrong or mutable, every comparison built on it is wrong.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The retriever is supplied through a documented function interface. Swapping it requires no change to scoring code.
Each question records the ranked passage IDs returned, recall@k for a declared k, and reciprocal rank of the first gold passage (0 when none is returned).
A retriever that raises on one question records that question as errored with the exception type and message, and the remaining questions are still scored.
Each run writes a new record containing the corpus identity, the retriever identity, k, per-question results and the time. No run overwrites or edits an earlier record.
Each run prints a one-line summary with mean recall@k, mean reciprocal rank and the errored count.

Automated tests check recall@k and reciprocal rank against hand-computed values for a retriever with known output, including a question whose gold passage is never returned, and pass at the submitted revision.
The learner explains why these two metrics were chosen, one question where they disagree and what each is telling, and what breaks first if k changes between runs.

constraints: Standard library plus a test runner only. No vector database or embedding library.
No network access and no model API. Every input is synthetic and generated or checked in by the learner.
Do not implement answer generation or grounding yet.
Do not push to a remote or open a pull request as part of this task.

scope.description: A scoring loop over a pluggable retriever and its immutable record.

investigation_areas: What a question with several gold passages means for recall@k and for reciprocal rank
How the retriever is identified so two different retrievers are never confused in records
Why a mean over questions can improve while an important question regresses
testing_expectations: Run the project's own test suite. State the exact command in the design; the learner chooses the runner and the layout.
documentation_requirements: Record the retriever interface, the metric definitions and the record format in the learner design.

next_task_preview.summary: Classify each answer as grounded, ungrounded or uncited, and never count a fabricated citation as support.
